This has been an issue since I started playing about 2 months ago. The GUI that's supposed to let you select your account keeps flickering in and out. I try to press the login button, then another window pops up and its just the close button. The recording doesn't show my mouse movements, but the size of the window is just the button size, a square. Somehow managed to get through it before but not this time.
